protocol: Fixed counts committed before training. Initial policy is eligible fallback. Development selects each checkpoint and overall champion by absolute normalized panel score on identical development decks/opponents, provided unopened AA fold probability <= max(.05, initial value+.01). Selection freezes before final tests; test size is never extended after results. Two paired tests vs respective old RL baseline, corrected 97.5% panel intervals.
environment: Six-player NLHE, fixed 0.5/1 BB, no rake, 1..1000 BB starts, unequal seats with occasional 0.01..0.99 BB remnants; four-hand training sessions carry stacks and rotate button. Bust seats get explicit simulated refill; other seats never reset inside a session.
reward: Net BB / max(10, initial effective stack BB), fixed before actions. No win/loss labels or future cards.
opponents: Training: 40% full current self-play; otherwise one learner vs old RL, HRC, historical policies and check-call/loose scripted styles. Evaluation: 60% old RL mixtures, 20% HRC mixtures, 20% styles.
limitations: Not a poker solver, no equilibrium guarantee, no online search.
No fresh HRC supervision; existing HRC models provide opponent diversity only.
Evaluation hands start independently; carried sessions are covered by training and technical tests, not a validated long-session winrate against humans.
1000 BB is the upper regular start range, not an inference limit or a guarantee for every depth.
Hero history is not used for training; no claim to have learned the specific human opponent.
